prose: Basis: Techmeme's feed summary of a Bloomberg article; the source fetch failed. Bloomberg reports Nscale is in talks for a second Anthropic deal worth about $45 billion, to deliver 460MW of computing power from its West Virginia campus using Nvidia's Vera Rubin-generation chips. The talks land the same week investors pushed back on Nscale's ~$30B IPO valuation - hyperscale contracted revenue is exactly what would defend that number.
highlights: Bloomberg: Nscale in talks for a ~$45B second deal with Anthropic
460MW from Nscale's West Virginia campus on Vera Rubin chips
Comes days after investor pushback on Nscale's ~$30B IPO valuation
Contracted hyperscale revenue would shore up the IPO case
